segments.text: Hi, good morning. Kahan se bol rahe hain aap?
Main bhi theek hoon. Kahan se hain aap?
Ji main Kanpur se bol rahi hoon aur aap kahan se bol rahe ho?
Shayad meri pehle baat jo ho chuki hai ek baar shayad raat mein I think main jahan tak aapki awaaz sun raha hoon.
Dr. Faiz? Haan haan yaad aaya. Haan Lucknow mein ab doctor hain na?
Us din aapse do minute baat hui, uske baad call cut kar gaya, phir uske baad aapka call lag hi nahi raha tha.
Toh haan, toh maine aaj aaj maine aapko favorite list mein dala hai toh aapka show kiya toh maine isliye.
Bas badhiya hoon aur kya ho raha hai?
Bas badhiya, kuch nahi. Main bhi toh room pe hoon.
Achha, toh aap toh yahan pe matlab aapka toh puri family yahan rehti hai na?
Saath mein hi rehte hain na?
Nahi nahi, Lucknow puri family rehti hai. Main toh mera toh hospital Hyderabad mein, aapko bataya toh tha.
Achha, Hyderabad mein doctor hain na aap?
Aap aap bhi married ho na? Housewife ho aap?
Housewife ho, tab aapne mujhe bataya tha, do minute mein baat hui thi, uske baad aapne kuch nahi bataya toh phir call cut kar gaya.
Achha achha. Haan hua hoga kyunki.
Shaadi ko 10 year ho gaye hain.
10 years ho gaye. Kitne bachche hain aapke?
Dono hain. Ladka, ladki dono hain.
Are matlab ek meri beti hai, 8 saal ki hai.

box_2d.text: Nahi, operation se normal kahan hote hain?
Husband kya karte hain aapke?
Phir kahan hi, phir toh phone ek kinare pada rehta hai, isse matlab hi nahi hota hai koi.
Mere ghar mein mere puri family hai, matlab mayke mein. Yahan bhi hum char log hain aur meri nand rehti hai.
Nand married hai na?
Toh is app ke baare mein kisne bataya tha? Aapka advertise, advertise dekha tha ya aapne?
Toh isi lalach mein isko download kiya tha maine.
Haan, earning toh hoti hai, bas par kabhi kabhi jaise free hote hain kaam waam karke toh on kar lete hain thodi der ke liye voice call.

Haan haan, ye aapne sahi kaha hai. Lekin haan, aisa hota hai kyunki kaafi log ismein bahut bure bure bhi, matlab seedhe direct jo hai aayenge aur bolte hain ki aap WhatsApp dijiye. Maine kaha dekhiye, ye kaam main nahi karti hoon. WhatsApp WhatsApp na main number deti hoon na kuch, bas sirf aur sirf audio call main karti hoon aur woh bhi dhang se aapko baat karni hai toh kar sakte hain, nahi toh anyatha jaiye aap, kaat dijiye call.
Achha.
Haan, bas aur as a as a doctor main main bhi married hoon.
Haan haan, wahi cheez hai. Toh bas.

Unki care karne ke liye bhi koi nahi hota, unse na koi puchega ki kya hua, kya nahi hua. Bas subah utho, bachchon ko school bhejo, husband ka tiffin banao, ab khana banaya, soya, yahi zindagi beet gayi.

Taaki mere paas jitni knowledge hai, woh main aapko doon, aap woh cheezein follow karo, study karo, aapko agar woh cheezein fayda karti hai toh aap logon ko batao. Isse kya hota hai, samajh ke andar ek achha review hota hai.
Yahi yahi yahi cheez main, yahi cheez main kar raha hoon.
Aapse baat karke bahut achha laga.
Meri yahan pata hai aapko, main batati hoon, abhi kal parson ek ladke ka phone aaya hai mere is phone pe, isi pe, dost application pe. Uski age pata hai aapko kya thi? 23 year ki age thi uski.
Theek hai.

Haan haan, sab pata chal jaata hai aur woh itna, main aapko sahi bataun, itna pyara singer, itna achha gaata tha woh. Matlab actually shauk mera bhi hai toh maine usse aise hi poocha, achha theek hai aap apni hobby wagera bataiye toh bola main toh Agra ka pagal, Agra ke pagal khane se bol raha hoon aur mujhe main toh gaana gungunata rehta hoon.
Haan.

Toh phir maine maine kaha achha theek hai, aap na jaise is application pe aap mujhe phir, aap mujhe dobara call kariye ga, toh main aapse baat karungi. Toh bola ki dekhiye main aaj aapko mil gaya hoon yahan pe, ab ye application delete kar dunga main aur ab aage ka din ye bhi nahi pata ki main zinda rahoon ki na rahoon.
Multimedia pe main koi cheez website pe istemaal nahi karta hoon, matlab na jaise ki woh Facebook, Instagram wagera kuch bhi nahi istemaal karta main.

Toh bola ki main agar jo main kisi se matlab number de deta hoon toh phir main matlab thoda sa attraction ho jaata hai usse, baat-cheet karne lagta hoon. Main thoda sa alag type ka hoon. Maine kaha achha theek hai, chalo koi baat nahi.
Toh bola application main raat ke 12:00 baje delete kar dunga, lekin last call main aapko karunga, sabse last call jo hogi.
Uske baad se maine mujhe khana banana tha toh maine rakh diya phone. Ab phir uske baad se maine hi nahi application on kari. Ab pata nahi usne kiya tha ki nahi kiya tha.
Nahi liya tha.
Haan, lekin woh matlab woh mujhe toota hua tha kaafi.
Achha achha.
